description: Shows the team's launch checklist: which setup steps are done, which remain, and the suggested next step. Use when the user asks what to do next, how far setup is, or what they have not tried yet. Not for plan usage or limits (use get_team_usage). Returns done and remaining steps with labels and overall completion.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_onboarding_progress
title: Get setup progress
